title: Global derived Hom complex
statement: For a scheme X and P,Q in D(\mathcal O_X), define the global derived Hom complex R\operatorname{Hom}_X(P,Q) to be the derived global sections of the derived internal Hom R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_X}(P,Q), viewed as an object of the derived category of abelian groups (and, when X=\operatorname{Spec}(R), as an object of D(R)). The construction uses the derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and derived global sections, and is functorial in P and Q.
